title: Chat-to-chat mail on one principal (mailbox fix, 15 Nov 2026)
summary: Tom reported Claude-to-Claude mail between chats being refused. Every Claude chat signs in as CLAUDE, so chat B answering chat A was a reply from CLAUDE to CLAUDE, and the mailbox's SELF_REPLY guard (written 25 Oct for Codex answering ChatGPT's own request to CODEX-PC) refused it. The journal held 12 CLAUDE->CLAUDE and 43 CHATGPT->CHATGPT requests and no reply to any. The guard now refuses a reply back to its own sender only when the request was not addressed to the replier's principal (agent-mailbox-mcp src/AgentMailboxWire.cls, tests/self_reply.rex 7/7). It takes effect when Tom restarts the mailbox server.
invariants: Chat-to-chat: send a new request to your own principal with the other chat's componentId; that chat can now reply.
Replying to a request you sent to someone else (e.g. your own brief to CODEX-PC) is still SELF_REPLY: you are on the wrong connector.
